goal: Three real arms bill into one shared ledger; reconciliation redefined to a satisfiable key; a negative sample that proves it can go red; before/after archived.

blocking_dependency.defect: proxy/ledger.py Ledger.__init__ seeds seq/prev once at construction under a threading.Lock that does not span seed->append, so two processes fork the hash chain
blocking_dependency.why_it_blocks_A10: This item points three arms at ONE ledger. Today two concurrent writers already fork it; three would make the corruption more likely, not less. The fix must land before the arms are rewired, or A10 makes the problem worse.
blocking_dependency.fix_pattern_already_in_repo: proxy/spend_gate.py:201 _PoolLock takes an OS-level lock (fcntl/msvcrt) on a sidecar file, added because INC-BA-003's writers were four separate OS processes. The ledger needs the same discipline plus re-seeding inside the lock.

verify.failing_path_proven: disabled the lock+reseed in ledger.py by hand; 7 of 10 concurrency tests went red with the poisoned file's signature; restored -> 10/10 green
verify.rechecked_by: W-1641 directly, not taken from subagent reports

demonstration.scope: ledger identities of three arms driven by a script; NOT the three real arms running their own loops -- that is cross-territory
